title: Solutions Overview
meta_description: 24 outcome-based solutions across growth, risk, operations and workforce — each anchored to named metrics, platforms and industry playbooks.

blocks.x: 24 outcome-based solutions — anchored to named metrics, platform stacks and industry playbooks.

Solutions are how clients buy outcomes rather than towers: a named business problem, a composed architecture, a platform stack and committed outcomes. They sit above the service towers and below the case studies — the bridge between capability and proof.

blocks.caption: Solutions at a glance
rows: conversion lift — clean-room verified per campaign
conversion rate — up 10-25% on rebuilt paths
venture cycle to MVP — under one quarter
fraud losses — down 30-45% at stable approval rates
time-to-recovery — proven against RTO in drills
disruption impact — down 30-50% on instrumented events
STP on target processes — up 25-45 points
knowledge-task time — down 30-50% on instrumented roles

blocks.x: Each solution composes services from two to four towers, runs on one or two platforms, and carries an industry playbook per sector. The pattern stays constant; the physics, regulations and KPIs change by industry.
Explore a solution — or describe your problem in a briefing and we will map it to the portfolio.
